canonical_name: Plain Paxos (Tom Cocagne) -- the essential Paxos roles (Proposer, Acceptor, Learner) and a practical variant with heartbeats and leadership, in Python, with its unit tests
lineage: Lamport's Paxos (1989/1998) -- quorum-based, asynchronous, single-decree consensus -- written as small readable classes (essential.py) plus a 'practical' layer (heartbeat-driven leader acquisition, message retransmission, durable state) and a 'functional' variant, each with tests. NOT Raft: no log, no explicit leader term, safety from quorum intersection alone. Widely read as the reference Python Paxos (the Java twin lives in src/).
version: github.com/cocagne/paxos master as of 2026-09-13 (commit in hashes)
compiler_or_interpreter: python 3.11 (docker python:3.11-slim); tests written for Python 2/3
entry_points: paxos/essential.py (Proposer/Acceptor/Learner), paxos/practical.py (Node, heartbeat leader), paxos/functional.py; test/test_essential.py etc.

example.input: the shipped message-passing tests (prepare/promise/accept/accepted, contention, leader loss)

human_capability_summary.built_to: let a majority of unreliable nodes agree on one value despite crashes and message loss, and keep agreeing when a leader dies
human_capability_summary.pressure: asynchrony, crash failures, duelling proposers (livelock is Paxos's known liveness hazard, which the practical layer's leader heartbeats exist to suppress)
human_capability_summary.success_means: no two learners learn different values; a value is learned once a quorum is available

human_environmental_pressure: partial failure, message loss, competing proposers
human_failure_condition: duelling proposers never decide (liveness), or -- if the quorum rule is broken -- two values decided (safety)
behavioral_entry_point: the tests' contention cases; drop acceptor replies and watch proposal numbers climb

lineage_relations.note: Raft (2014) is a redesign of Paxos for understandability; this is the ancestor family

nyx_handoff.how_to_run_it: recipe.json (runner docker); python -m techne.fossils.harvest run cocagne-plain-paxos
nyx_handoff.what_humans_used_it_for: let a majority of unreliable nodes agree on one value despite crashes and message loss, and keep agreeing when a leader dies
